claims.statement: Existing agentools/sdk owns AgenTools\ from src/, PHP >=8.3, proprietary/private; native PHP/Dart and optional private-paired MCP surface remain.
Scoped local Composer manifests and exact locks are recorded; none registers the selected new platform package names or prefixes. Availability is local only.
P1.2 records choice C direct transport, null selected SDK and one future AgenTools loop; no production implementation or live qualification.
P1.3 records the exact ten dated statuses, additive PHP/Dart baseline and direct/offline/legacy bridge obligations.
Existing PDO adapters implement EventStore/fenced leases/token consume. EffectCommitter local append alone does not prove committed intent before effect IO.
CostRecorder exposes input/output token counts and integer versioned-price-table calculation; it is not an extended nullable metering or money ledger owner.
P1.1 source inventory provides 41 capability IDs. Historical migration/facade dispositions are not target obligations and are replaced by the grouped M2 decisions here.
